description: sdd-gap-detector --semantic judge: one item per (requirement, code chunk), state = {requirement: {id, statement, criteria}, code: {path, start, end, code}}. The skill takes the max over the chunks of a requirement; a requirement split across files can score low on every chunk, so low scores are never proof of absence and go to the LLM.

implements.instructions: Does `code.code` implement the behavior described by `requirement.statement` (as checked by `requirement.criteria`), rather than just mentioning related names?

criteria.true: The code performs the required behavior: the trigger is handled and the required response is produced
criteria.false: The code does not perform this behavior, or only touches related data

partial.instructions: Does `code.code` implement only part of `requirement.statement`, for example the main path but not the error cases listed in `requirement.criteria`?

related.instructions: Is `code.code` about the same feature or domain concept as `requirement.statement`, even if it does not implement it?
